name: find-todos-produce-report
description: Multi-tool workflow: grep to search for TODO/FIXME comments across the codebase, then write_file to create a report. Tests grep + write_file pipeline.
task: Search the entire Yrden codebase (Sources/ and Tests/ directories) for all TODO and FIXME comments. Create a file called TODO_REPORT.md in the repository root that lists each finding with its file path, line number, and the comment text. Group findings by file. Include a count of total TODOs and FIXMEs at the top.
